caption: The drawing depicts a traditional-style cloak and its variations, primarily in shades of red, cream, and subtle blue accents. The central object is a knee-length cape featuring a bright red yoke, collar, and center front panel, with cream-colored side panels. The red yoke and border are decorated with intricate floral patterns in gold, green, and white, as well as scalloped edges. The cream panels are embellished with large, stylized red flowers outlined in matching color, and leafy vines extending from the center. The garment is fastened at the neck with a black tasseled cord, and the inner lining is depicted in pale blue with a diamond-shaped grid pattern. To the right of the main cloak, there are two smaller illustrations showing alternate views: one is a full-length view from the front, focusing more on the overall silhouette and distribution of the motifs; the other is a close-up of the yoke and upper panel, emphasizing the embroidery and clasp detail. All three depict the same colors and decorative motifs, arranged on a plain off-white background. The artist's signature, "A. Gray," appears at the lower right of the drawing.
title: Opera Cloak
